name: Sortable

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The items rendered as reorderable rows. Two-way bindable via ItemsChanged, which also fires after a drag/touch/keyboard reorder.

parameters.name: ItemsChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the freshly-reordered list whenever an item is moved, via drag, touch, or keyboard.

parameters.name: ItemTemplate
parameters.description: Render fragment for each item's content, receiving the item.

parameters.name: Handle
parameters.description: Restricts dragging to a dedicated grip handle on each row instead of the whole row. Default true.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables drag, touch, and keyboard reordering, rendering the list as static.

parameters.name: Group
parameters.description: Optional shared-group name. Lists that use the same non-empty Group (within one user session) let rows be dragged from one list into any position of another, via mouse, touch, or the keyboard (focus a drag handle and press ArrowLeft / ArrowRight to send the row to the previous / next list of the group). The source list raises ItemsChanged without the item, the target list raises it with the item inserted at the drop index, and OnTransfer fires on both. Lists with a different or empty group never exchange rows, and a list only accepts items that are assignable to its TItem. The group name is also emitted on the container as data-sortable-group.

parameters.name: OnTransfer
parameters.description: Raised on BOTH the source and the target list after a row has moved between lists that share a Group (via drag, touch, or keyboard), in addition to the two ItemsChanged notifications. Does not fire for in-list reorders (see OnReorder).

parameters.name: OnReorder
parameters.description: Raised in addition to ItemsChanged whenever an item is reordered (via drag, touch, or keyboard), carrying the moved item along with its old and new indices. Does not change the ItemsChanged contract.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Optional selector that returns a stable, unique key for each item. Providing this ensures Blazor's diffing engine tracks items by identity rather than index — critical for drag-reorder to map DOM state correctly. If omitted, the item reference itself is used as the key.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes merged onto the list container.

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Captures any unmatched attributes and applies them to the list container.

events.name: ItemsChanged
events.description: Raised with the freshly-reordered list whenever an item is moved, via drag, touch, or keyboard.

events.name: OnTransfer
events.description: Raised on BOTH the source and the target list after a row has moved between lists that share a Group (via drag, touch, or keyboard), in addition to the two ItemsChanged notifications. Does not fire for in-list reorders (see OnReorder).

events.name: OnReorder
events.description: Raised in addition to ItemsChanged whenever an item is reordered (via drag, touch, or keyboard), carrying the moved item along with its old and new indices. Does not change the ItemsChanged contract.

records.name: SortableMoved
records.signature: SortableMoved(TItem Item, int OldIndex, int NewIndex)
records.description: Payload describing a single reorder: the moved Item and its OldIndex / NewIndex within the list. Supplied to OnReorder.

records.name: SortableTransfer
records.signature: SortableTransfer(TItem Item, string Group, string SourceListId, int OldIndex, string TargetListId, int NewIndex)
records.description: Payload describing a row that moved between two lists of the same Group: the moved Item, the shared Group, the DOM ids of the SourceListId / TargetListId containers (data-slot="sortable-list" elements), and the index it left (OldIndex, in the source list) and now occupies (NewIndex, in the target list). Supplied to OnTransfer.

examples.title: Basic Sortable List
examples.code:
<SortableList TItem="string" Items="@_tasks" ItemsChanged="@(v => _tasks = v)">
    <ItemTemplate Context="item">
        <Lumeo.Text Class="text-sm">@item</Lumeo.Text>
    </ItemTemplate>
</SortableList>

examples.title: No Handle (drag entire card)
examples.code:
<SortableList TItem="string" Items="@_tasks" ItemsChanged="@(v => _tasks = v)" Handle="false">
    <ItemTemplate Context="item">
        <Lumeo.Text Class="text-sm">@item</Lumeo.Text>
    </ItemTemplate>
</SortableList>

examples.title: Rich Item Template
examples.code:
<SortableList TItem="TaskItem" Items="@_tasks" ItemsChanged="@(v => _tasks = v)">
    <ItemTemplate Context="task">
        <Flex Class="items-center gap-3 w-full">
            <DynamicIcon Name="@task.Icon" Class="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <Stack Gap="0" Class="flex-1">
                <Lumeo.Text Class="text-sm font-medium">@task.Title</Lumeo.Text>
                <Lumeo.Text Class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">@task.Assignee</Lumeo.Text>
            </Stack>
            <Badge Variant="Badge.BadgeVariant.Secondary">@task.Priority</Badge>
        </Flex>
    </ItemTemplate>
</SortableList>

examples.title: Shared Group (drag between lists)
examples.code:
<SortableList TItem="string" Items="@_todo" ItemsChanged="@(v => _todo = v)" Group="tasks"
              OnTransfer="@(t => Log(t.Item, t.OldIndex, t.NewIndex))">
    <ItemTemplate Context="item">@item</ItemTemplate>
</SortableList>
<SortableList TItem="string" Items="@_done" ItemsChanged="@(v => _done = v)" Group="tasks">
    <ItemTemplate Context="item">@item</ItemTemplate>
</SortableList>

mdSummary:
# Sortable

Drag-and-drop reorderable list.

**Package:** `Lumeo` · **Category:** Drag & Drop
**Docs:** https://lumeo.nativ.sh/components/sortable

## Parameters
| Owner | Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sortable | Items | `List<TItem>` | `[]` | The items rendered as reorderable rows. Two-way bindable via ItemsChanged, which also fires after a drag/touch/keyboard reorder. |
| Sortable | ItemsChanged | `EventCallback<List<TItem>>` | `` | Raised with the freshly-reordered list whenever an item is moved, via drag, touch, or keyboard. |
| Sortable | ItemTemplate | `RenderFragment<TItem>?` | `` | Render fragment for each item's content, receiving the item. |
| Sortable | Handle | `bool` | `true` | Restricts dragging to a dedicated grip handle on each row instead of the whole row. Default true. |
| Sortable | Disabled | `bool` | `false` | Disables drag, touch, and keyboard reordering, rendering the list as static. |
| Sortable | Group | `string?` | `` | Optional shared-group name. Lists that use the same non-empty Group (within one user session) let rows be dragged from one list into any position of another, via mouse, touch, or the keyboard (focus a drag handle and press ArrowLeft / ArrowRight to send the row to the previous / next list of the group). The source list raises ItemsChanged without the item, the target list raises it with the item inserted at the drop index, and OnTransfer fires on both. Lists with a different or empty group never exchange rows, and a list only accepts items that are assignable to its TItem. The group name is also emitted on the container as data-sortable-group. |
| Sortable | OnTransfer | `EventCallback<SortableTransfer>` | `` | Raised on BOTH the source and the target list after a row has moved between lists that share a Group (via drag, touch, or keyboard), in addition to the two ItemsChanged notifications. Does not fire for in-list reorders (see OnReorder). |
| Sortable | OnReorder | `EventCallback<SortableMoved>` | `` | Raised in addition to ItemsChanged whenever an item is reordered (via drag, touch, or keyboard), carrying the moved item along with its old and new indices. Does not change the ItemsChanged contract. |
| Sortable | Key | `Func<TItem, object>?` | `` | Optional selector that returns a stable, unique key for each item. Providing this ensures Blazor's diffing engine tracks items by identity rather than index — critical for drag-reorder to map DOM state correctly. If omitted, the item reference itself is used as the key. |
| Sortable | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the list container. |
| Sortable | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures any unmatched attributes and applies them to the list container. |

## Slots
- `ItemTemplate` (Sortable) — Render fragment for each item's content, receiving the item.

## Events
- `ItemsChanged` (`EventCallback<List<TItem>>`) — Raised with the freshly-reordered list whenever an item is moved, via drag, touch, or keyboard.
- `OnTransfer` (`EventCallback<SortableTransfer>`) — Raised on BOTH the source and the target list after a row has moved between lists that share a Group (via drag, touch, or keyboard), in addition to the two ItemsChanged notifications. Does not fire for in-list reorders (see OnReorder).
- `OnReorder` (`EventCallback<SortableMoved>`) — Raised in addition to ItemsChanged whenever an item is reordered (via drag, touch, or keyboard), carrying the moved item along with its old and new indices. Does not change the ItemsChanged contract.

## Sub-components
- `SortableList`

## Cascading values it expects
- (none)

## Services it injects
- `IComponentInteropService` (Lumeo.Services)
- `ILumeoLocalizer` (Lumeo.Services.Localization)

## Keyboard
- `ArrowUp` — OnHandleKeyDown handles ArrowUp in SortableList.razor
- `ArrowDown` — OnHandleKeyDown handles ArrowDown in SortableList.razor
- `Home` — OnHandleKeyDown handles Home in SortableList.razor
- `End` — OnHandleKeyDown handles End in SortableList.razor
- `ArrowLeft` — OnHandleKeyDown handles ArrowLeft in SortableList.razor
- `ArrowRight` — OnHandleKeyDown handles ArrowRight in SortableList.razor

## Example
```razor
<Sortable />
```

## CSS variables
`--color-border`, `--color-card`, `--color-foreground`, `--color-muted`, `--color-muted-foreground`, `--color-primary`, `--color-ring`, `--radius`
